In each time step, the cell can decide what to do with the state vector: read from it, write to it, or delete it, thanks to an explicit gating mechanism. With the input gate, the cell can decide whether to update the cell state or not. With the forget gate the cell can erase its memory, and with the output gate the cell can decide whether to make the output information available or not.
